data.scope: Four black-box DIRECT and GIT_WORKTREE assignment scenarios using test-owned temporary paths and local Git only.
data.side_effects: Creates and normally removes test-owned OS temporary directories, local Git repositories, worktrees and evidence; on failure may retain a test-owned directory; no network, service launch or repository user-file writes.
data.risk_review: Inspected test path bounds, local Git arguments, cleanup and imported runtime; side effects are confined to OS temporary paths.
